issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in its credibility assessment of the principal appellant's bus-driving job and extortion claims
issues.applicant_position: Argues the RPD's credibility findings were wrong; details to follow if necessary.
issues.result_text: The RPD did not err in its credibility assessment.

issues.issue: Whether the Mexican context explains the contradictions in the appellant's testimony
issues.applicant_position: The RPD erred by not considering the Mexican context of the alleged events.
issues.result_text: Mexican context cannot explain the contradictions and vague testimony; the appellant did not show how it does.
